title: ChanceSMP modpack
body:
🌎 Chance SMP Modpack

Welcome to the official Chance SMP modpack — where survival turns into chaos. ⚔️

This modpack was made to keep Minecraft feeling vanilla while making everything bigger, harder, and way more cinematic. From huge adventures and hidden bases to wars, betrayals, and alliances, every moment on the server becomes part of the story. 🎬

One day you’re building with your team…
The next day they’re raiding your base. 👀

✨ Features
🌲 Better world generation
🏰 New structures & exploration
⚡ Performance improvements
🛠️ Quality of life mods
⚔️ PvP & survival enhancements
🎥 Immersive gameplay for content creators
👥 Multiplayer-focused experience

Whether you want to:

💰 Become the richest player
👑 Start a kingdom
🧨 Cause chaos
📖 Create lore
🏹 Fight wars
🏠 Build massive bases

…there’s always something happening on the Chance SMP.

🌐 Server IP

Chancesmp.xyz

⚠️ Important

Please don’t use hacks, xray, or unfair exploits.
The fun of the server comes from the chaos, strategy, and player interactions.

🔥 Every choice matters.
🤝 Every alliance can break.
📜 Every player has a story.

Welcome to Chance SMP.
